t: You're on Lansdowne Terrace, a street in Bloomsbury, in WC1. It takes its name from William Petty, who was Earl of Shelburne and later the first Marquess of Lansdowne. He was an Anglo-Irish Whig statesman, the first home secretary in 1782, and then prime minister during the final months of the American War of Independence. He secured peace with America, and that remains his most notable legacy. So the name on the street sign points back to a prime minister.
